column1: Purpose: Track the 100 media partners you want to work with and manage your outreach and relationship building with them.
1. Pull your 10 media partner categories from Step #1.
2. Fill in the Company Name for 100 media partners across those buckets, picking each one carefully instead of filling a quota.
3. Fill in the Founder Name, Founder Email, Founder Phone, Website, Founder LinkedIn, Founder Twitter/X and Founder Instagram as you find them.
4. Use the Additional Info columns for anything else you find, and the Outreach Notes for anything you want to remember about a partner.
5. Verify the data using Million Verifier, your VA, or both, before you start any outreach.
6. Date the Email Sent, Call Made, LinkedIn Sent and Twitter Sent columns as you go, and work through the whole list every 10 working days.
